in_marathi.name: Jotish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jotish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jotish is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jot' which means 'Knowledge' and 'Is' which means 'He'. This name is given to a boy who is considered to be a source of wisdom and knowledge. Jotish is believed to have a deep understanding of the world and a strong desire to learn and explore new things.
